Preparation:
•Clean fan.
•Tighten all screws.

Instructions:
•Draw a dot on masking tape and place it on the fan.
•Number the blades.
•Hold phone under the fan and record the wobble.

Check Wobble:
•Simply point the camera at the dot to get the wobble strength in realtime.

Balance Fan:
•Place a clip on each blade. Record the wobble of each blade. The best position to place counterweights is determined.
